scene.speaker: freya
scene.bubble: My bedroom is my little world: my bed, my books, my toy box… and Pip sleeping on my pillow!
scene.intro: Freya's bedroom is her little world. There is a small bed with a blue blanket, there is a yellow lamp, there is a clock on the wall and there is a big toy box in the corner. And there is one puffin under the pillow — Pip again! Is he sleeping? Yes, he is. What is in YOUR bedroom? Is there a lamp? Is there a picture? Come in and look with Freya!

words.clue: It gives you light at night.
It tells the time. Tick tock!

activities.title: Match the thing with its place.
Listen to Freya's bedroom. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.script: Freya: This is my bedroom! My bed has a pink blanket. … Tomas: And what a big toy box! … Freya: There are twenty toys inside. My favourite is the little boat. … Tomas: What is on the wall? … Freya: A picture of the lighthouse. Grandpa painted it! … Tomas: And on the shelf? … Freya: My books. Seven books! … Tomas: And who is sleeping on your pillow?! … Freya: Pip! Every afternoon. It's his favourite place.
